prompt:
Author ONE production isometric RPG game-animation sprite sheet: SIX independently articulated HIT-REACTION poses of exactly the original 지배자 기르타스 (Girtas), ALL facing SOUTH-WEST, screen LOWER-LEFT, FRONT-LEFT three-quarter view. Use ONLY the attached original portrait and faithful canonical identity references, plus the optional explicitly described rear guide. Preserve the PALE VISIBLE FACE in views where it is anatomically visible, LONG PALE/WHITE HAIR, exact gold head structure, THIN NARROW HARD-GOLD RADIAL SPINES, dark gold-trimmed armor and LONG DARK GOLD-TRIMMED SKIRT, original boots, and ONE LONG SINUOUS ORIGINAL GLOWING WEAPON. No red mask or substitute demon face, no short-skirt armor redesign, no broad replacement wings, no extra weapon or new anatomy. Preserve exact original head/torso/feet proportions and material identity. 

ABSOLUTE DIRECTION IS DECISIVE: ALL SIX have SOUTH-WEST, screen LOWER-LEFT, FRONT-LEFT three-quarter view. The pale visible face, front chest armor, hips and toes aim distinctly DOWN-LEFT toward the viewer. Do not turn to horizontal WEST or rear-left. The original anatomical RIGHT weapon arm is the far/upper-left side in this front-left view, its actual grip and blade remain readable toward IMAGE LEFT. Do not put the weapon into the near left hand; the other hand stays unarmed. Helmet/head, shoulders, chest/back, pelvis and toes all agree with that exact compass direction through the ENTIRE sequence. Keep the same elevated orthographic isometric camera. Reaction changes PITCH, neck/shoulder/elbow/hip/knee articulation and stance, never the body YAW/facing. Do not turn into a front pose, north pose, opposite side or easier neighboring direction at maximum recoil. Anatomical RIGHT hand holds the same single long sinuous weapon throughout; any necessary real perspective occlusion must remain coherent rather than switching the weapon hand. Never mirror a different direction.

Six real chronological bodily impact phases in left-to-right then down order: (0) stable brace in the requested facing, feet supporting weight and original weapon held low; (1) impact from an unseen enemy directly IN FRONT of the character along the requested heading jolts torso/shoulders/head BACKWARD, knees begin flexing and free arm counterbalances; (2) MAXIMUM actual torso/head/shoulder recoil with coherent neck/spine/hips and articulated knees, pale hair and long skirt lag physically while exact requested body heading is unchanged; (3) a balanced stagger and counterstep of the original feet, one foot bears weight and the other braces back, original hips/knees/ankles recover balance without extra limbs or a side turn; (4) recover torso over the supporting feet, arms/hair/skirt settle; (5) controlled recovered guard in exactly the same compass heading, a distinct settling pose. In rear views show only back helmet/hair/armor, never a front face or front chest emblem during recoil. Keep the original weapon low and non-offensive; this is HIT reaction, NOT an attack slash, death, bow or weapon flourish. Six true independently drawn joint/body responses, not repeated poses, global translation/rotation, tint/opacity changes, camera movement, motion blur or ornamental glow substitution.

Technical MINIATURE atlas:1024x1536 PNG, EXACTLY TWO COLUMNS and THREE ROWS, SIX512x512 cells. ONE complete character in each cell. Aim for about280-300px helmet-to-boots body and full silhouette at most330x330px INCLUDING every narrow gold needle tip, full long curved blade and tip, hair, long skirt and boots. Keep each in its central330x330 area with at least91px completely empty transparent gutter on EVERY cell edge. More than70percent of the page stays empty. DO NOT enlarge figures to fill the page. Same actual head/torso/feet pixel scale in all six. Re-angle attached existing equipment coherently; never crop, shorten, omit, detach, or shrink one pose. No character bounding-rectangle overlap or cross-cell glow/blur.

Detailed crisp game cutouts, readable pale hair/face where appropriate, gold trim and fully opaque dark armor/skirt. Gold/fire brightness stays inside the original real solid chest/weapon/spine surfaces; no diffuse outer glow. Alpha0 outside exact silhouettes and in all gaps, edge antialiasing only1-2pixels. No floor, shadows, scene, background panels, bloom, haze, fog, halo, dust, lightning trails, text, labels, numbers, grid, spare parts or extra figures. Final sheet must show SIX genuine readable HIT responses of the faithful original Girtas in the exact requested SW compass direction, retaining the original single weapon in the same anatomical RIGHT hand.
